answer: A sybil farm can forge a thousand accounts, but rarely a thousand distinct minds. Similarity pooling: each epoch, answers are embedded and clustered, and every cluster of near-duplicates splits a single reward, whatever its size. The farm's paraphrased templates sink into one sable pool, so 1,000 fakes earn what one honest writer earns, while a truly original answer stands apart like ivory and keeps its full share. Limit: an attacker running many genuinely different models can still slip past the clustering.
